chapter: Stuff Smith, 52nd Street and session work
title: Meeting Stuff Smith in Buffalo and joining at the Onyx Club
summary: Cole met Stuff and Jonah Jones jamming in Buffalo and replaced Johnny Washington at the Onyx Club on 52nd Street.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: For RCA. But, well let's see, you were with Willie, and then the next thing I see in Chilton is that you were with Stuff Smith.

After Willie. Now, I met Stuff in Buffalo, at the time I was with Willie Bryant. We was working this club in Buffalo that I couldn't think of the name, and Stuff is out of Buffalo, that's his home. He used to come by down at the Union and Stuff and I used to sit downstairs and jam in the afternoon, and that's how we become acquainted.
Was he still with Alphonso Trent or was that later?

I think so, Alphonso Trent and then he had a little trio somewhere over at Toppy's there in Buffalo. He and Jonah and all them, I met Jonah at the same time. And I don't think he was with Alphonso Trent then.
Because that band broke up in Buffalo.

Yeah, yeah. I think Stuff had His own little trio or quartet then at the time I met him. Well, when they had a drummer with him, a boy named Johnny Washington which was also out of Buffalo. So they came to New York and they were on 52nd Street, and I think Johnny Washington had enough of the road, he wanted to come back home to

Buffalo and so Stuff asked me would I like to join the band, so I said yes, and then's when I joined the band, out of Willie Bryant's band, I would join Stuff at the Onyx Club on 52nd Street. There I stayed, oh goodness, I was with Stuff quite a while till I joined Cab Calloway. And then oh goodness, all during that time that I was with Stuff, is when I started to do records with everybody, you know like with Bunny Berigan, Dick McDonna and Carl Kriss..
